scope: Direct GPL-to-GPL port of the retained isolated two-craft docking fixture into the native host, with solved rigid presentation, D1 CAD rest surfaces, fixed replay and structural capture cue. Shared locked-DOF joint telemetry correction discovered by a known-load regression. Not full Bevy retirement or live-fleet docking UI.

contract.physics_owner: Existing thessa_collision::CollisionWorld and thessa_sim_core::DockingSession; the game fixture supplies two 300 kg / diagonal 400 kg m2 bodies, the retained central/eight-cuboid proxies, initial +/-1.5 m and -/+0.02 m/s states, +/-1.4 m ports and a 350 N actuator load for two seconds. No second solver, trajectory prediction, or direct pose animation.
contract.time: Fixed 1/120 s solver dt with bounded 0..0.05 s presentation admission. Headless --docking-time 0..30 seeks before warmup and quantizes down to a fixed tick; --docking-step 0..0.05 (default 1/60) includes warmup, zero freezes. Completed fixture freezes the final solved state like the legacy demo. Invalid/mixed flight/server/map/site/preview/time controls fail before asset/world loading.
contract.render: Existing opaque mesh, materials, RT/shadow and per-primitive instance-range path; two solved instances, no new pass/backend. A body-space anchor one million metres above the survey bookmark is presentation only, never fed into the isolated zero-gravity vacuum solver as an orbit or live vehicle state.
contract.cad: D1 GLB's authored node transforms are flattened with explicit decode_glb_rest_pose; clips are not sampled, matching the old unanimated inspection. Default decode_glb still rejects clips; both retain skin/extension/external-resource rejection and identical budgets. Native maps the actual glTF +Y mating normal (STEP +Z after export) to +/-X, fixing the old +Z assumption; a geometry regression pins the thin axis.
contract.inspection: HUD reads solved state/gap/velocities/pressure progression/joint count/latest-substep reaction and transformed collision-shell preview. Readout/camera/mesh extraction do not step or mutate the fixture. There is no FlightAuthority, server replica, map forecast or starter engine plume in this mode.
contract.audio: One consumed capture event with solved relative speed; authored 110 Hz / 180 ms structural cue only for the explicit diagnostic cabin listener attached to craft A. Exterior vacuum, mute, headless tests and seek remain silent; no acoustic-power or impact-spectrum calibration claim.
contract.telemetry_fix: Rapier 0.35 stores the final small-step impulse, not a full-frame sum. Locked-DOF force readback now divides by dt/num_solver_iterations rather than dt. Angular generalized impulses additionally pass through Rapier's public quaternion-error Jacobian at queried frames before normalization; its aligned-frame basis is half a rotation matrix. No hard-coded factor tied to default iterations. Motor/limit impulses, full-frame averages/peaks and high-speed/large-misalignment certification are not implied.
contract.capture_metadata: native_docking_fixture identifies the isolated mode and native_docking_clock explains its fixed replay versus authority/ephemeris state. Existing GPU interval layout remains unchanged.
